title: Re: Egypt support for Founders Club retreats
subject: Re: Egypt support for Founders Club retreats
body:
Hi Paula,

As the 2027 calendar takes shape, one idea for an international edition: a Founders Club retreat in Egypt, between February and April.

Three ways it could work: a Giza summit with a private evening facing the Pyramids, a Red Sea retreat in El Gouna, or a small mastermind on the Nile between Luxor and Aswan. Your team keeps the members, the programme and the speakers; NOYA runs the venues, stays, movement and everything on the ground.

Happy to share the detail and talk it through whenever suits.

Best,
Adam Elshazly
Founder, NOYA Concierge
noyaconcierge.com

sources.fact: On 6 Oct Paula wrote that she will reach out if an opportunity arises, and that she looks forward to hearing from us.
